Panelz · the endless comic · biome EIGHT of eight

The Rimewatch

The frozen edge, where the trail ends and everybody who set out to find what is past it stopped.

I The towns and the roads between them

4 towns and a boss lair, 0 roads between them. Each card is the town's own panels, in the order they are played. A road is a thing between two towns: a town names where it leads on to, and the toll on a road is the level the town at its far end asks of you.

II Who is out on those roads

10 opponents can be run into in The Rimewatch, and one boss waits in the lair. Each one is shown as the panels it brings to a fight, left to right in the order a fight plays them.

Meeting the encounter opening, and whatever it says before anyone swings
Attacks the windup and each attack it can make
Hurt what it does when it is hit, and any status or phase it goes through
Ending you slip away, or it goes down

IV Legend · everything they can leave behind

Every item on this biome's drop tables, what it is worth, what it does while it is in the bag, and who parts with it.

Frostbite Fang

780 gold · 2 kg
  • Weapon · Frost Bite, 15–25 damage

A tooth from something that lived out here. It is still cold, and it did not get that from the weather.

dropped by
Rimeghoul 75% Thaw Troll 50%

Glacier Heart

1190 gold · 1 kg
  • +4 Strength while carried
  • +3 Agility while carried
  • +4 Intelligence while carried

Ice from the middle of the oldest thing out here, set in a collar of frayed rope and worn against the chest. It has been thinking about something for a very long time, and it lends you the thought.

dropped by
Icefall Judge 75% Glacier Tooth 50% Thaw Troll 50% The Yoked 50% The Trail's End 29%

Hoarfrost Bulwark

820 gold · 11 kg
  • Armour · takes 38% off a hit, never more than 28

Ice grown deliberately over a frame, layer on layer, until it stopped being ice and started being wall.

dropped by
Hoarfrost Draugr 60% Glacier Tooth 50% Icefall Judge 25% The Yoked 25%

Last Lamp

760 gold · 1.5 kg
  • +6 Agility while carried

The furthest light anybody carried out here. It was still burning when they put it down, and by it you see every step.

dropped by
Lure Wight 60% Snowblind Yeti 40% The Last Camp 33%

Snowblind Veil

705 gold · 0.8 kg
  • Armour · takes 24% off a hit, never more than 2

A slitted veil against the glare. It turns out to help against more than glare.

dropped by
Snowblind Yeti 60% Drift Herd 40% The Last Camp 33% Rimeghoul 25%

Wintering Cloak

975 gold · 3 kg
  • +5 Strength while carried
  • +4 Agility while carried
  • +3 Intelligence while carried

Made to be slept in. Whoever gets to keep their strength overnight out here has already won something, and wrapped in this you also keep your balance and your head.

dropped by
Drift Herd 60% Lure Wight 40% The Last Camp 33%

Jotun's Walking Staff

1000 gold · 5 kg
  • Weapon · Last Mile, 22–32 damage

An iron-shod ash staff taller than any man, worn smooth where a giant's hand held it. Whoever carried it last walked until they could walk no further, and it was found still standing.

dropped by
The Trail's End 43%

Rimebound Greatsword

850 gold · 8 kg
  • Weapon · Rime Cleave, 20–28 damage

Frost grows back onto the blade faster than you can wipe it off. It has stopped being a problem and started being the point.

dropped by
Hoarfrost Draugr 40% The Trail's End 29% The Yoked 25%
